description.raw: '''Passive:''' '''Miss Fortune''' gains [[File:Movement speed icon.png|15px|link=Movement speed]] '''bonus''' movement speed after 4 seconds without taking non-[[File:Blaze.png|20px|link=Damage|An icon representing the keyword Persistent damage]] [[:Damage|periodic]] damage. This bonus is increased after another 3 seconds, and is granted instantly whenever ''Strut'' is cast.
description.text: Passive: Miss Fortune gains  bonus movement speed after 4 seconds without taking non- periodic damage. This bonus is increased after another 3 seconds, and is granted instantly whenever Strut is cast.

description2.raw: '''Active:''' '''Miss Fortune''' gains [[File:Attack speed icon.png|15px|link=Attack speed]] '''bonus''' attack speed for 4 seconds.
description2.text: Active: Miss Fortune gains  bonus attack speed for 4 seconds.

description3.raw: Marking a new target with ''[[File:Miss Fortune Love Tap.png|20xpx|border|link=Miss Fortune#Love Tap|An icon for Miss Fortune's ability Love Tap]] [[Miss Fortune#Love Tap|Love Tap]]'' reduces ''Strut's'' [[File:Cooldown icon.png|15px|link=Cooldown]] '''current''' cooldown by 2 seconds.
description3.text: Marking a new target with Love Tap reduces Strut's  current cooldown by 2 seconds.

leveling.raw:
'''Bonus Movement Speed:'''
30 / 35 / 40 / 45 / 50
'''Increased Bonus Movement Speed:'''
60 / 70 / 80 / 90 / 100
leveling.text:
Bonus Movement Speed:30 / 35 / 40 / 45 / 50
Increased Bonus Movement Speed:60 / 70 / 80 / 90 / 100

notes.raw: * The bonus movement speed is not lost from taking [[Damage#0_Damage_Instances|0 damage instances]].
notes.text: The bonus movement speed is not lost from taking 0 damage instances.
